<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 64 64" role="img" aria-label="Tagent">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tg-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fb923c"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#f97316"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ea580c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tg-glow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.28"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- app tile -->
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="60" height="60" rx="14" fill="url(#tg-bg)"/>
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="60" height="26" rx="14" fill="url(#tg-glow)"/>
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="60" height="60" rx="14" fill="none" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-opacity="0.35" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- terminal prompt: ❯ _ -->
  <path d="M16 19 L28 26.5 L16 34" fill="none" stroke="#fff7ed" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <rect x="33" y="30" width="16" height="5.5" rx="2.75" fill="#fff7ed">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1;0.25;1" keyTimes="0;0.45;0.55;1" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
</svg>
